# Layout Patterns

::: {.cards-3 .tight}
::: {.card .compact}
**Structured narrative**

- Section include files
- Shared style + deck overrides
- Small, composable slide units
:::


::: {.card .compact}
**Reusable commands**

- `quarto preview`
- include-aware watcher
- section-focused edit mode
- Docs: [quarto.org/docs/presentations/revealjs](https://quarto.org/docs/presentations/revealjs/)
:::

::: {.card .compact}
**Math + references**

- Generated MathJax macros
- BibTeX citations with hover
- Optional refs-slide suppression
:::
:::


You can also feel **free** to use *arbitrary* markdown directly in the slide content.
